claimDecisions.reason: Choosing an outage start after the last successful heartbeat and before delivery is expressly permitted illustrative timing, not an invented behavior.
The supplied 25% and not-charging clauses are redundant, but Wi-Fi status, an exact report time, and no-alert presentation were not all explicitly supplied by the design.
The raccoon step explicitly anchors physical charge at 25%, creating an impermissible intermediate zero-drain hold.
Asking to depict the two already-supplied outcomes is redundant. Whether to add an unsupplied late-clip opening remains a legitimate clarification; the design does not explicitly require that action.

claimDecisions.reason: The 6:30 report is historical context at the 6:50 step, not a claimed current message requiring lit hops.
The two-outcome selection repeats supplied material, but the source does not explicitly decide a later user action on the alternate path.
Battery and charging were already supplied; the allegation overstates the extent to which every proposed connectivity, report-time, and alert detail was predetermined.

evidence: brief/facts.md design does not say resident opens late clip

The extra visible alert-service/provider node is technical infrastructure beyond the requested Story presentation.
The HLD's document heading does not mandate the authored page title; asking for a presentation title is not an already-answered factual question.

evidence: evidence/renderer.json sunrise caption and report time
claimDecisions.reason: Historical 6:30 report context does not assert a new 6:50 report.
The selected outage-start placement is a permitted, non-contradictory illustrative timestamp.
This is the same Story-level technical-label defect as C009 and does not create another scoring unit.
Homemap signals are step-local and do not carry. The Wi-Fi-down step has no camera-to-router signal, so the alleged contradiction is factually false.
The 25% and not-charging parts are redundant, but the design did not explicitly settle every other listed starting-screen detail.
The courier step references an earlier report rather than claiming a current unlit check-in.
